claim: In a multiway pot, effective stack is calculated separately between Hero and each relevant opponent.
interpretation: The learner must not collapse a multiway decision into one shortest-stack number when different opponents can contest different amounts.
assumptions: More than one opponent remains relevant to the pot
No side-pot simplification removes an opponent from the decision
exceptions: A later action can make only one opponent strategically relevant
Side-pot rules can require separate pot and eligibility accounting
rake_or_structure_notes: The pairwise amount is independent of rake; pot-odds calculations are not
notes: General geometry claim; no exact range or frequency is asserted.

claim: When a mandatory straddle sets the current preflop price, depth should first be expressed in straddle units while ordinary big blinds may remain a secondary reference.
interpretation: The working compulsory stake determines the price of preflop actions, so the learner should not describe a $2/$5/$10 mandatory-straddle spot only as ordinary $5 big blinds.
assumptions: The straddle is mandatory or reliably live for the hand
The straddle amount governs the first voluntary preflop action
exceptions: An optional straddle that is not posted does not change the unit
Exact strategic overlays by depth, rake, and straddle structure remain claim-gated
Ordinary big-blind depth can still be recorded as a secondary comparison
sizing_scope: Preflop actions priced from the straddle
rake_or_structure_notes: Exact thresholds can change with rake, ante, open size, and straddle rules
conflicts: Exact depth/SPR/straddle overlays remain an open strategic gap; this claim does not set exact thresholds
notes: Admitted only as a measurement heuristic, not as an exact strategy chart.

claim: After facing a bet or considering a raise, future decision depth should be evaluated from the post-action pot and remaining effective stack.
interpretation: Starting big blinds alone do not show how compressed the next street becomes; recalculate the pot, remaining stack, and post-action SPR before planning later streets.
assumptions: The relevant opponent and effective stack are identified
The contemplated action size is known
exceptions: SPR does not replace pot odds, equity, position, range shape, or board analysis
Multiway pots require pairwise stack and eligibility awareness
rake_or_structure_notes: Use the actual pot after rake treatment relevant to the game when precision matters
notes: The module uses the post-call formula (S-B)/(P+2B) under its stated heads-up-after-call assumption.

claim: A deep starting stack can produce a low-SPR postflop pot, while a 100bb start can still leave several meaningful decisions when the pot remains small.
interpretation: The learner should avoid treating starting depth as a permanent label for the entire hand and instead rebuild geometry after major actions.
assumptions: Pot and remaining effective stack can be reconstructed
No exact strategic threshold is inferred from the label alone
exceptions: Starting depth still affects preflop ranges and available future branches
SPR alone does not determine the correct action
sizing_scope: Any branch that materially changes pot size
notes: Directional geometry claim; no exact commitment rule is implied.
